provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

translations.en: and one day, the mighty being may awaken.

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: It is clearly very old,

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: yet it is well preserved, without even a wormhole.

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: This must be the scroll in question.

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

translations.en: You! What are you doing here?

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: That's our line!

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: What are you sneaking around down here for?

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: That is none of your concern.

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: Hmph. You were planning to silence us from the start anyway!

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: I'm counting on you. We can't back down now.

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: Let's do this!

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: We've beaten them, sure, but...

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: how far had they got with the ritual?

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: You have defeated @7rBeatrix@0r and her companions,

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

translations.en: but you cannot tell how far their crucial ritual had progressed.

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: were carrying out some kind of work.

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: But what were they working on?

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: probably dead, so you cannot ask them.

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: Y-you...

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: What... have you done...?

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: Oh, you're still alive.

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: We're going back to the outside world, no matter what.

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: I won't let you stop us!

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: No one... was trying to...

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: So this is the creature at the heart of the seal!

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: Oh, what have you done...?

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

translations.en: The seal will warp, and the demon god will return!

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
provenance.context_review: Inherited draft; edition-specific occurrences require review

translations.en: What...?

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City

provenance.project: Wizardry Prisoners of the Lost City
